content_sections.heading: About MDSU
content_sections.text: Major Dhyan Chand Sports University is located in Meerut and was established by the State of U.P. Legislature Act No 08 of 2021. This notice, issued by the Registrar on 20 November 2026, invites guest faculty for the academic session 2026-27.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application form is addressed to the Registrar, duly completed. It is to be forwarded by email to [email protected] between 20 November 2026 and 05 December 2026. The notice does not print the form itself, an email subject line or the time limit on the last date.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: A master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. In addition, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET. Those who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. degree in accordance with the UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments are exempted from NET/SLET/SET. Such candidates are governed by the ordinances, bye-laws or regulations of the institution awarding the degree, and are exempted from NET/SLET/SET if all of these conditions are met: The fulfilment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the university concerned. Alternatively, the Ph.D. may have been obtained from a foreign university/institution ranked among the top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by Quacquarelli Symonds (QS), Times Higher Education (THE) or the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of Shanghai Jiao Tong University. Desirable: 1 year of teaching (theory and activity) in any Institute/University. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

rows.pay: Rs. 1500 per lecture, maximum Rs. 50,000 per month for session 2026-27

content_sections.heading: MDSU Sports Psychology Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct assigned classes. Fulfil other academic duties. Maintain academic records such as lecture notes, attendance and evaluation report. Participate in departmental meetings and other assigned academic activities.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice says shortlisted candidates will be engaged as Guest Faculty. The schedule of the interview and other requirements for shortlisted candidates will be intimated separately on the university website. No TA/DA is payable for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The engagement is temporary, for academic session 2026-27 or till regular appointments are made or till further order/requirement, whichever occurs earlier, without any right or likelihood of permanent appointment. The honorarium is Rs. 1500 per lecture, subject to a maximum ceiling of Rs. 50,000 per month for session 2026-27. The guest faculty is not entitled to allowance, pension, gratuity, leave, etc., as admissible to a regular Assistant Professor/lecturer or teacher. The engagement may be terminated with prior notice if performance or conduct is deemed unsatisfactory. The number of posts may be increased or decreased, and the university reserves the right not to engage or to withdraw any advertised post. The engagement is need-based and does not confer any claim, status, equivalence, seniority or entitlement for the regular post of Assistant Professor, nor is it an appointment against any approved regular post. Guest faculty must comply with university rules, regulations, policies, discipline and code of conduct. Any dispute is subject to the jurisdiction of the competent court at Meerut.
